ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "The Communications Industry: Places, Practices and the Pillsbury Doughboy" . This course will cover a variety of topics designed to help students learn more about the communication industry, with an emphasis on the organizations, people and practices that make things happen in advertising, public relations, journalism and media. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen and students in the Weston Exploration Program. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
